hero.subheadline: A locally owned family tile business in operation for over 60 years. Walk the showroom, pick your tile and ask Wayne about your shower, floor or bath.

intro.h2: See the tile, then see it installed
paragraphs: Preferred Tile, LLC is a family-owned tile store in Statesboro with over 60 years in operation. The showroom on N Zetterower Avenue carries porcelain, natural stone, mosaics and tile in all sizes, and Google reviewers say the staff are knowledgeable and experienced.

The shop also installs. Bathrooms on its Facebook page include walk-in showers with built-in niches and benches, mosaic accent bands, pebble shower floors and travertine walls. One customer says Wayne and his guys have done several custom houses for them and calls the crew always professional. If you are planning a shower, a floor or a full bath, start with a visit.

items.name: Tile showroom and selection
items.blurb: Browse porcelain, natural stone, mosaics and tile in all sizes on display at 9 N Zetterower Ave. Google reviewers describe the staff as great people with years of experience and knowledge. Bring your room measurements and a few photos so they can help you choose.

image.alt: Inside the Preferred Tile showroom: racks of tile sample boards, display stands and a wood-look tile floor

items.name: Custom tile showers
items.blurb: Walk-in showers with built-in niches, tiled benches and mosaic accent bands, in anything from bright marble-look porcelain to rustic stone-look tile set on the diagonal. The shop posted one of these as the perfect shower for a master, a girls' room or a guest bath.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with white marble-look tile, a mosaic accent band, a recessed niche and a tiled bench

items.name: Bathroom tile remodels
items.blurb: Full bathroom tile work, including travertine walls, pebble shower floors, tiled half walls with glass panels and tiled tub decks. One Facebook post sums up a project simply: lots of work done for this beautiful bathroom. Bring your plans and ask what the job involves.

image.alt: Bathroom with travertine tile walls, a pebble shower floor behind a tiled half wall and a white vanity with a vessel sink

items.name: Tile for custom homes
items.blurb: Preferred Tile also tiles new homes. Jamie writes that Wayne and his guys have done several custom houses for them and calls the work the best of the best. If you are building, call and ask for Wayne to talk through your tile.

image.alt: Bathroom with a tiled drop-in tub deck under a large window and a walk-in shower beside it

why_choose_us.h2: Why Statesboro comes to Preferred Tile

items.title: A family business with history
items.text: Preferred Tile describes itself as a locally owned family business that has been in operation for over 60 years, and it is still based in Statesboro today.

items.title: Knowledgeable people
items.text: Google reviews describe great staff with years of experience and knowledge, and great people who are very knowledgeable, so you get real help choosing tile.

items.title: See it in person
items.text: The showroom displays porcelain, natural stone and mosaic tile in all sizes, so you can compare color, texture and finish side by side before you buy.

items.title: The owner picks up
items.text: Wayne owns the business and asks customers to call the store and ask for him by name, so builders and homeowners can talk to the person in charge.

about.h2: About Wayne and the Preferred Tile family
about.text: Preferred Tile, LLC is a locally owned family business in Statesboro, Georgia. Wayne is the owner, and when a customer had a problem he answered on Google and asked them to call and ask for him by name. The store is at 9 N Zetterower Avenue, in a showroom lined with tile boards and sample displays. The family has also held tile yard sales behind the building, with porcelain, natural stone, mosaics and tile in all sizes. Finished showers and baths are shared on the Facebook page.

image.alt: Preferred Tile storefront at 9 N Zetterower Ave in Statesboro with a white pickup truck parked outside

process.h2: How to start your tile project

steps.title: Visit the showroom
steps.text: Stop by 9 N Zetterower Ave, Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM, and see the tile in person.

steps.title: Choose your tile
steps.text: The staff help you compare porcelain, natural stone and mosaics and pick what suits your shower, floor or bath.

steps.title: Plan the install
steps.text: Before anything starts, ask Wayne who will do the work, when it can be scheduled and exactly what is included.

steps.title: Install and follow up
steps.text: Your tile goes in on the agreed schedule. If anything needs attention later, call the store and ask for Wayne.

items.name: Jamie M.
items.text: Wayne and his guys have done several custom houses for us! Always professional and the best of the best! Highly recommend!

service_area.text: Preferred Tile, LLC is at 9 N Zetterower Ave in Statesboro, Georgia, and the projects on its Facebook page are from the Statesboro area. Homeowners and builders come to the showroom to pick tile and plan showers, floors and baths. If your home is outside Statesboro, call (912) 764-7767 and ask Wayne whether installation is available where you live and how scheduling works.

items.q: What kinds of tile do you carry?
items.a: Porcelain, natural stone, mosaics and tile in all sizes, the same range the store lists for its tile sales. Stock changes, so the best way to see what is in now is to visit the showroom at 9 N Zetterower Ave, Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM, or call (912) 764-7767.

items.q: Do you install tile or just sell it?
items.a: Both. The shop posts finished showers and bathrooms on its Facebook page, and its crew has tiled custom homes for local clients. When you plan your job, ask who will do the installation, how scheduling works and what is included, so you know exactly what to expect.

items.q: How long have you been in business?
items.a: Preferred Tile describes itself on Facebook as a locally owned family business that has been in operation for over 60 years. Wayne is the owner today. If you have a question about your project, call the store at (912) 764-7767 and ask for him by name.

The showroom is open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. You can call (912) 764-7767 during those hours, or email Preferredtilellc@gmail.com with your room size, a few photos and the look you have in mind.

Yes. One client has had Wayne's crew tile several custom houses and calls them always professional. Builders can call (912) 764-7767 and ask for Wayne to talk about tile selections, quantities and installation schedules for new homes, or bring plans to the showroom on a weekday.

final_cta.h2: Come see the tile in person
final_cta.text: Visit the showroom on N Zetterower Ave or call Wayne to plan your shower, floor or bath.
